removal_reason: Chromatogram array size is primarily a file-format/acquisition sampling detail; little standalone quality value.
Global extreme single intensity vulnerable to noise, clipping, one exceptional peak and MS-level mixing.
Adjacent absolute TIC-change quartiles are a local transform; needs anomaly-detection benchmarking.
Estimated centroid/profile detection is algorithm-dependent; record estimator version and ground-truth accuracy.
RT IQR mostly reflects scan timing and gradient length; redundant with run duration/scan rate.
Central RT-scan density duplicates rate/timing family and lacks clear demonstrated incremental utility.
Middle-half scan-index TIC is a proxy rather than ID-based QC; validate added value beyond median TIC.
Shortest half-scan RT-window TIC median is a proxy; test interpretability and failure sensitivity.
MS2 adjacent TIC change quartiles are a specialized local derivative lacking independent validation.
MS2 centroid/profile estimator has method/algorithm dependence and questionable benefit over recorded peak types.
MS2 RT IQR largely duplicates run length and timing, with limited demonstrated QC value.
MS2 RT interquartile density overlaps scan rate and timing summaries.
<=15 Th threshold is method-dependent and arbitrary; 15 Th equals both <= and >= bins.
>=15 Th threshold is method-dependent and arbitrary; 15 Th equals both <= and >= bins.
Number paired with isolation width duplicates eligible-count/coverage bookkeeping.
95th/5th precursor intensity ratio is an arbitrary-tail proxy; sensitive to low 5th percentile and zeros.
Modal fraction of MS2-per-cycle count duplicates cycle quantiles/mode without established extra quality value.
Absolute eligible cycle count duplicates eligibility fraction plus cycle count.
Distinct target-set count is a newly derived method-fingerprint statistic; needs known-method ground truth.
Modal target-set fraction is method fingerprint; benchmark reliability and utility vs simpler widths/targets.
Ordered target-sequence cardinality is sensitive to vendor encoding and cycle segmentation.
Modal target-order fraction is experimental; assess robustness under staggered and variable-window DIA.
Charge minimum duplicates the charge histogram and is highly sensitive to one outlier.
Charge maximum duplicates histogram and is sensitive to misassigned extreme charges.
